description: Return nearest-site cells clipped to an explicit axis-aligned rectangle.
output_invariants: Return nearest-site cells clipped to an explicit axis-aligned rectangle. Outputs are detached; order and indices are stable.

behavior.validation: Accept exactly the input keys and plain JSON-compatible objects/arrays, finite numeric values (not booleans), and safe integer count/budget fields. Validate complete input before computation. maxWork is required nonnegative safe integer. No coercion, defaults or hidden allocation retries. Failure throws an Error with stable code. No partial result. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0.
behavior.environment: No RNG, noise, time, renderer, assets or host state. Coordinates use caller units, x right and y down in p5 examples; algorithm works in either coordinate orientation. Inputs are copied or read only, output detached; no retained aliases.
behavior.numerics: IEEE754 binary64 separate arithmetic operations, no epsilon in classification or topology. Reject every nonfinite computed intermediate with NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. General coordinate and length comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; integer indices, output order and topology compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exactly representable cases and exact comparison. No exact-predicate robustness promise for nearly degenerate inputs.
behavior.algorithm: bounds=[minX,minY,maxX,maxY] with minX<maxX and minY<maxY. Sites may lie outside bounds; empty sites yields cells=[]. Produce one cell per site in original order. Exact duplicate sites (signed zero equal) belong only to first site; later cells=[]. Start each cell [(minX,minY),(maxX,minY),(maxX,maxY),(minX,maxY)]. For each other site in input order, skip equal duplicate, clip by a*(x-midX)+b*(y-midY)<=0 where a=other.x-site.x,b=other.y-site.y,midX=site.x+a/2,midY=site.y+b/2. Visit polygon edges previous->current with previous initialized last vertex; inside-inside append current, outside-inside append intersection then current, inside-outside append intersection, outside-outside append nothing. Intersection t=dPrevious/(dPrevious-dCurrent), point=previous+t*(current-previous). Boundary is inside. No coordinate snapping.
behavior.canonicalization: After each clip remove consecutive exactly equal points including duplicate closing point. Retain collinear vertices. At completion remove cells with fewer than three vertices or exactly zero signed double area (sum cross-products in polygon order). Preserve rectangle winding; rotate each nonempty polygon to lexicographically smallest [x,y] vertex, first occurrence wins. Empty/point/line cells are []. Numeric rounding can collapse cells; no repair or exact geometric guarantee.
behavior.budget: Before processing, charge N*N work for duplicate/comparison preflight (safe arithmetic required). Then charge one work unit for each polygon edge visited during clipping. If total would exceed maxWork, throw WORK_LIMIT before that visit. Empty input costs 0. Worst-case O(N^3) clipping work, O(N^2) retained output, bounded by supplied maxWork; no universal latency guarantee.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export voronoiCells2D(input) from packages/javascript/src/voronoi-cells-2d.js; plain output matching output_schema. Other targets deferred.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Malformed input, nonfinite supplied number or violated shape/domain constraint.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: Required work exceeds explicit maxWork, or work-count arithmetic is not a safe integer.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: A computed geometry or scalar intermediate is nonfinite.
